latitude
label: Latitude (north)
description: The latitude of your place, from 25 to 65 degrees north (not for the tropics or the southern hemisphere). The plate is drawn for it: the horizon, the almucantars and the azimuths all change with it. Southern latitudes are not offered: the Jig projects from the south celestial pole, as northern astrolabes do.

name: mater_diameter
label: Diameter of the instrument
description: Outside diameter of the mater, the limb included. Everything scales from it.

name: sheet_thickness
label: Sheet thickness
description: Brass sheet for the plate, rete, rule, back plate and alidade. The limb is twice this. The maximum follows the diameter, so that no slot or hole comes out narrower than the sheet is thick.

name: plate_density
label: Altitude step on the plate
description: How far apart the almucantars are engraved. Azimuth lines are every 15 degrees either way.

name: line_width
label: Engraved line width
description: Width of the engraved lines: the cutter or laser spot. Its maximum follows from the closest lines at your latitude and step.

name: engraving
label: Engraving in the model
description: Shown as dark lines: the instrument as it will look, quick to change. Prepared for the engraving export: the plate lines are cut as real grooves whose floors are one drawing, so that the set Plate engraving exports; this rebuilds more slowly. Set it last, just before exporting. The limb and back engravings export in either mode.

name: star_count
label: Stars on the rete
description: How many bright stars the rete carries: the brightest first, from the Yale Bright Star Catalogue, epoch J2000.0, between -19 and +65 degrees declination. Each pointer carries a letter on its boss; the key is: A Sirius, B Arcturus, C Vega, D Capella, E Rigel, F Procyon, G Betelgeuse, H Altair, I Aldebaran, J Spica, K Pollux, L Deneb, M Bellatrix, N Alnilam, O Alioth, P Mirfak, Q Dubhe, R Alkaid, S Menkalinan, T Alhena, U Mirzam, V Alphard, W Hamal, X Diphda, Y Alpheratz, Z Mirach, 1 Saiph, 2 Rasalhague, 3 Algol, 4 Denebola, 5 Sadr, 6 Schedar, 7 Alphecca, 8 Eltanin, 9 Almach, 0 Enif.

name: lettering
label: Lettering
description: Star letters on the rete (the key is in the description of Stars on the rete; stamp them with letter punches) and the latitude on the plate; or only the hour numerals I to XII twice on the limb and the degree scales, for a plain instrument.

name: kerf
label: Laser kerf
description: Width of the cut. Pin and locating holes are drawn smaller by half the kerf, so they come out at size; the other outlines are not compensated: outside edges finish half a kerf small, which the fits allow.

name: sidereal_time
label: Local sidereal time (hours)
description: Turns the rete: the star on the meridian is the one whose right ascension equals this time. Drag it to run the night.

name: rule_angle
label: Rule
description: Turns the rule over the rete, as you would to read an hour off the limb scale.

name: alidade_angle
label: Alidade (on the back)
description: Turns the sighting bar on the back; its end reads altitude on the back scale, in degrees above the horizontal.

title: Planispheric astrolabe
description: A planispheric astrolabe for your latitude, 25 to 65 degrees north, in brass: a mater with a degree scale and hour numerals, a plate with almucantars, azimuths, equator and tropics in exact stereographic projection, a rete of 12 to 36 lettered star pointers with the ecliptic ring, a rule, and on the back an altitude scale with an alidade; pin, wedge, throne and ring. Not for places nearer the equator than 25 degrees or in the southern hemisphere. Drag Local sidereal time to turn the sky, Rule and Alidade to read them. The star key is in the description of Stars on the rete. To export the outlines: File > Export, Sheet of set: Laser cut sheet, as DXF or SVG. To export the engraving: Sheet of set: Limb engraving and Back engraving in either mode; for Plate engraving first set Engraving in the model to Prepared for the engraving export (a slower rebuild). Each is one drawing in true position. The star letters are stamped by hand.
